Definition: from G473 and G906; to bandy:--have.
BiblicalUsage: Luke says the two on the road to Emmaus talked together of all these things which had happened, communing as they walked. The word means to bandy words back and forth, to talk a matter over between friends.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for talking over carries no doctrine of its own; its tenderness is the road to Emmaus, that two sad friends talked their grief out until Jesus joined them.
